entities.name: Tadeusz Lehr-Spławiński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tadeusz Lehr-Spławiński was a Polish linguist, scholar, and professor of Slavonic studies. He was twice elected rector of the Jagiellonian University in Kraków before and after the Nazi German occupation of Poland.
